_note: Selected once from the seeded ten-image development subset; frozen before evaluation. Standard inference was used for tuning. The sliced benchmark arm reuses these model settings with the default tile settings below.
selection_rule: Minimum mean absolute covered-count error; tied settings fall within the minimum-MAE setting's 95% image-level bootstrap interval; then normalized L1 distance to configs/default_settings.json; then faster mean inference.

yolov8n.rationale: Best MAE 3.5000 with 95% image-bootstrap CI [0.7000, 8.3000]; 24 setting(s) tied by that interval; selected MAE 5.2000 at normalized L1 distance 0.0000 from defaults, then mean inference time 170.4 ms.

yolov8s.rationale: Best MAE 3.5000 with 95% image-bootstrap CI [1.3000, 6.3000]; 24 setting(s) tied by that interval; selected MAE 3.5000 at normalized L1 distance 0.0000 from defaults, then mean inference time 912.3 ms.

rtdetr-l.rationale: Best MAE 3.2000 with 95% image-bootstrap CI [0.9000, 6.0000]; 6 setting(s) tied by that interval; selected MAE 5.6000 at normalized L1 distance 0.0000 from defaults, then mean inference time 3845.5 ms.
